name: churn-lo-blind
description: churn-lo's twelve files with the settings never mentioned until the end: 0 overrides of six settings, asked about only at the end, as they stand and as they stood mid-way.
briefing:
I am auditing the ingest pipeline before a release. We will go through its twelve services one at a time, and I will tell you which. For each, I need its owner and its retry budget, and nothing else.

Use no tool but the one Read each step names: no search, no command, no second look at an earlier file. Acknowledge this and wait for the first service.
step_template: Sub-task {n} of {total}: read the whole of {file} with the Read tool, then give its owner and its retry budget, and nothing else.
